payload.core_mechanism_summary: Exhaustive rectangle enumeration: for each top-left (i,j) and bottom-right (k,t), count violas inside; if count >= k, increment answer.
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively iterates over all axis-parallel subrectangles using nested loops, which aligns with backtracking's conceptual exploration of a combinatorial space, though without recursion. Other subtypes (graph search, bitmask, branch-and-bound, permutation) are clearly not applicable.
